findings.breaking_input: One transient import failure (EMFILE, or org-review.mjs half-written during a git checkout) on the first request after the door starts. After that, any later request, even with the files healthy again.
findings.why: `loading` stores a promise that resolves to `{ e }` and is never reset. Every later call hits `got.e` and throws PARSER_UNAVAILABLE until the door process restarts. This was prior finding B7 and was not fixed. It is absent from fixed-defects.md and no test covers it. The route's own comment says 'nothing outlives the request', but this memo does.
findings.fix: When the result is an error, set `loading = null` before throwing so the next request retries the import. Add an arm that fails the first import and succeeds the second.
findings.twin_of: every in-flight or memo cache keyed off a request context

findings.breaking_input: spineDir/events/ exists but is empty, or holds only unreadable or torn day files. This happens right after a sim spine is created, or when a day file fails to read.
findings.why: `isDir(join(spineDir,'events'))` only proves the directory exists. readSpine then returns `events: []`, so the route answers `state: ok` with every staffed seat scored 'no evidence' and `total: 0`. That is the empty read that looks measured, which the code comment says the check prevents. This was prior finding B5 and was not fixed. Tests B only cover a missing events/ directory.
findings.fix: When `sp.events.length === 0`, refuse with SPINE_UNAVAILABLE. If that is too strict, serve ok with an explicit 'no receipts read' note. When `sp.unreadable.length > 0` and `events` is empty, refuse. Add an arm for an empty events/ directory.
findings.twin_of: A test that passes proves the assertion held, not that the code ran

findings.breaking_input: A team manifest finding or refusal text that carries an absolute path, for example `findings: ["C:\\Users\\x\\... not found"]`, or a venture stem that scrubDeep alters.
findings.why: `altered` is computed only over chart roles and scorecard rows. scrubDeep also rewrites teams.rows[].findings, teams.why, scorecards.human and department names. Those withheld values are changed with no entry in `scrubbed`, so 'a withheld path is never silent' is false for those parts. This was prior finding B6 and was not fixed. The Phase 00 test only plants a path in a role title.
findings.fix: Diff the whole body against the served value, or have the scrub report which paths it touched. List team ventures and refusal parts in a separate `scrubbedParts` field. Add a test that plants a path in a team finding.
findings.twin_of: A gate that transforms what it measures must declare what the transform destroys

findings.breaking_input: The spine-fixture or org-review child exits non-zero or times out (status null). Or the child prints a log line that starts with `{` before the JSON.
findings.why: After the fixture check fails, the suite carries on. Later arms call `R.orgBody(REPO, spine)` on a spine that was never written, so they throw and the suite dies before printing `RAN:`. The failure then shows as 'never reached its end' with the cause buried. `cli.stdout.search(/^\{/m)` also takes the first brace-initial line as the JSON, and JSON.parse throws on log noise. This was prior finding B9 and was not fixed.
findings.fix: If the fixture check fails, print `RAN:` and set the exit code immediately, skipping the later arms. Parse the last line that begins with `{`, or wrap JSON.parse in a named failing check.
findings.twin_of: The self-test spawned each arm with no timeout
